evidence.claim: Members of the Hayden Survey noticed this unusual arrangement in the late nineteenth century and proposed that an ancestral Colorado or Gunnison river had carved the canyon. Its origin remains debated: later explanations include a river cutting the gorge or uncovering an older canyon beneath sediment.
